item.title: Bulletin updated at 04:50 HKT 12/Mar/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A surge of the northeast monsoon will reach the coast of Guangdong tonight. It will be slightly cooler over the region in the following couple of days. The weather will be mainly fine and dry during the day. With the monsoon moderating gradually in the middle and latter parts of this week, temperatures will rise over the coast of Guangdong. It will be humid with mist over the region this weekend.

Date/Month: 12/03 (Sunday)
Wind: Light winds force 2. Becoming north force 4, force 5 at night, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground.
Weather: Sunny periods. Visibility relatively low at first. Rather warm during the day. One or two rain patches later.
Temp range: 20 - 27 C
R.H. range: 55 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low
